kpis.formula: minimum of per-competency weighted_kappa for ordinal levels and ICC(2,k) for continuous scores against the adjudicated expert golden set
recommendations rated relevant by the approved expert-teacher evaluation / all recommendations evaluated in the approved Top-N query set
eligible golden queries with at least one relevant accessible result in ranks 1 through 5 / all eligible golden queries
important answer claims with at least one valid and accessible citation / all important answer claims
requests whose final output validates against the required schema within the allowed initial attempt plus at most one repair / all requests requiring structured output
sum of valid pilot survey scores normalized to 100 / count of valid pilot survey responses
approved improvements due for the release that are implemented and verification-PASS / all approved improvements due for the release
count of externally transmitted payloads classified RESTRICTED at the authorization point
count of unresolved WCAG 2.2 AA violations in the required automated and manual critical-journey evidence set
recovery objectives with institution-approved target and fresh isolated-drill PASS evidence / all required recovery objectives

inference_contract.family_probability_formula: sum of the two operational-profile probabilities belonging to the family

objectives.scope: database, object storage, and version manifest
document index rebuild with citation validation

recovery_objectives.acceptance_rule: Each target requires institution approval and fresh isolated-drill PASS evidence before KPI-010 can PASS.

release_gates.required_evidence: design verifier PASS with no baseline, link, ID, or placeholder drift
required lint, type, unit, integration, build, migration, seed, and E2E checks PASS
Critical/High findings, cross-tenant leaks, and RESTRICTED external egress all equal 0
KPI-001, KPI-002, and KPI-005 satisfy their baseline comparisons
KPI-003 and KPI-004 satisfy their baseline comparisons
KPI-006 and KPI-009 satisfy their baseline comparisons
KPI-010 satisfies its baseline comparison and all implementable operations, backup, restore, and DR controls PASS
KPI-007 and all required pilot acceptance cases PASS

gate_aggregation.implementable_kpi_rule: A KPI with acceptance_data_required=false MUST be PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED and MUST NOT be REQUIRES_ACCEPTANCE_DATA.
gate_aggregation.acceptance_kpi_rule: A KPI with acceptance_data_required=true may be REQUIRES_ACCEPTANCE_DATA only when every implementable prerequisite test and data-contract check for that KPI is fresh PASS and the only absent input is an explicitly named external institution, expert, pilot, provider, or recovery acceptance record.
gate_reduce_order: If any required non-KPI evidence or KPI result is FAIL, the gate is FAIL.
Else if any required evidence is BLOCKED, MISSING, or STALE, the gate is BLOCKED.
Else if every implementable KPI and prerequisite is fresh PASS and at least one acceptance-data KPI is REQUIRES_ACCEPTANCE_DATA, the gate is REQUIRES_ACCEPTANCE_DATA.
Else if every required evidence and KPI result is fresh PASS, the gate is PASS.
gate_aggregation.mixed_gate_invariant: REQUIRES_ACCEPTANCE_DATA can never conceal an unexecuted, failed, blocked, missing, or stale implementable KPI or prerequisite.
gate_aggregation.empty_kpi_gate_rule: A gate with kpi_ids=[] is reduced from its required non-KPI evidence by the same FAIL, BLOCKED/MISSING/STALE, PASS order.

path_rules: release_id is one path segment and MUST NOT contain slash, backslash, colon, percent-encoding, NUL, dot-segments, trailing dot, or trailing space
resolve both docs/releases/ai-training-platform/{release_id} and dist/docs/{release_id} from canonical non-reparse roots and require each resolved child to remain strictly below its root
reject a root or child containing a symlink, junction, mount-point redirect, or Windows reparse point
never accept an absolute path in place of release_id
release_identifier_policy.tag_rule: An ACCEPTED/public release requires immutable annotated refs/tags/{release_id} whose peeled commit equals document_snapshot_commit and whose attestation binds source_commit and SHA256SUMS.txt. A pending candidate records release_id and source_commit but MUST NOT fabricate or move a tag without human approval.

signature_policy.pending_state_rule: CODE_COMPLETE / ACCEPTANCE DATA PENDING requires every technical signature and detached artifact/checksum signature to verify. OWN-ACC must have a scoped record with status REQUIRES_ACCEPTANCE_DATA, missing_input_ids, owner, due_at_utc, and candidate hashes; that record is not MISSING and is not an acceptance signature.
signature_policy.accepted_state_rule: ACCEPTED additionally requires OWN-ACC acceptance decision and signature plus the immutable annotated release tag attestation.
signature_policy.not_ready_rule: A missing or invalid technical signature, missing scoped OWN-ACC pending record, failed gate, blocked evidence, or stale evidence makes the release NOT_READY.

rules.when: any required gate is FAIL or BLOCKED, or any required evidence is missing or stale

all implementable KPI results, prerequisite tests, non-acceptance gates, technical signatures, and artifact signatures are fresh PASS; one or more acceptance-data KPIs are REQUIRES_ACCEPTANCE_DATA with a complete scoped OWN-ACC pending record; and no blocking evidence condition exists
every required gate is PASS with fresh evidence, including institution, expert, pilot, provider, and recovery acceptance inputs
